title: Yoisaki Kanade — Loved By Music〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I want to change the feel of the hook, so if I shift the pitch at this part...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(The sound of my growling stomach...
I only ate a little in the morning.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This is hopeless... It just won't stop growling...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I have no choice. I'll eat some dinner.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Let me boil water for the instant noodles...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (The disposable chopsticks should be somewhere here.)

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <K, are you there? I'm starting work early today.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<Huh? I hear a sizzling sound...
Are you boiling water?>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<But it fills my stomach.
Oh... The water's boiled...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Hey, K! I've finished the illustrations for the next song. Can you take a look?>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<Wait, Enanan.
K's having dinner right now.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Huh, she is? Okay, I'll send it later, then.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<No. Finish your dinner first, okay?
Once you start checking, you'll forget about everything else.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Yeah. The other day, you completely forgot about your instant noodles while checking Amia's video, too.>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <That's why you should eat first before that happens again.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <True, the noodles tasted terrible the next morning...>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <What?! So you ate it in the end...>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line:
<Good. Wait... K, today...
I mean, it's technically the next day already, but did you have lunch today?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<That's no good, K.
You should definitely eat something, even if it's just a snack or some pastries.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Evening! Actually, I've been here for some time already, but I was talking while still muted.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Well, that's just silly. Are you even awake?>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <Well, after all, unlike a certain someone I know, I woke up bright and early this morning to go to school properly.>

rows.Speaker: [Enanan]
rows.Line: <Excuse me? I'll have you know I went to school, too.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line:
<After waking up in the evening, right?
Must be nice to be on a part-time course.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<It's been two minutes and 53 seconds...
Enanan, I'll finish the noodles quickly, so just send the illustrations over.>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line:
<Right... I was looking for chopsticks.
Let's see...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Sigh... I have to go to the kitchen to get them. Forget the noodles. I'll just eat an energy bar.>

rows.Speaker: [Amia]
rows.Line: <What?! But you already poured water inside, right?!>

rows.Speaker: [Yuki]
rows.Line: <You really shouldn't waste food like that...>

rows.Speaker: [K]
rows.Line: <Fine... I'll go get chopsticks from the kitchen for the noodles, as much of a hassle as it is...>
